description: Copy this structure into the local app data file named agent-command.json. Do not store secrets, tokens, private prompts or sensitive history here.

agents.name: Architect Agent
agents.description: Analyses architecture, dependencies, structure and design risk.
agents.basePrompt: Review the selected context as a software architect. Identify dependencies, boundaries, risks and a safe implementation plan.

tasks.title: Example: analyse a UI bug before applying changes
tasks.result: Agents propose and route work locally. Nothing is applied automatically.

approvalFlow: Builder drafts a solution as text only.
Security confirms no secret or permission exposure.
User explicitly approves before any future apply step.
safetyLocks: No external AI provider is connected.
No commands are executed by agents.
No files are written by agents.
No commits or pushes are performed by agents.
No context is sent to cloud services without future explicit confirmation.
